name: worm-os-webusb-installer
description: Secure WebUSB installer for Worm OS on Google Pixel 10 frankel.

scripts.deploy:check: bash -n scripts/deploy-production.sh && bash -n scripts/update-production.sh && test -f dist/index.html && test -f nginx/worm-webusb.conf && grep -q "root /var/www/worm-webusb;" nginx/worm-webusb.conf && grep -q "try_files \$uri \$uri/ /index.html;" nginx/worm-webusb.conf && grep -q "Permissions-Policy.*usb=(self)" nginx/worm-webusb.conf && grep -q "Content-Security-Policy" nginx/worm-webusb.conf && grep -q "worker-src 'self' blob:" nginx/worm-webusb.conf && grep -q "auth_request /auth-verify;" nginx/worm-webusb.conf && grep -q "proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8787/auth/check;" nginx/worm-webusb.conf && ! grep -q "auth_basic" nginx/worm-webusb.conf && ! find dist -type l -print -quit | grep -q . && ! find dist \( -path '*/keys' -o -path '*/keys/*' -o -path '*/source' -o -path '*/source/*' \) -print -quit | grep -q . && ! grep -R "unsafe-eval\|unsafe-inline" dist nginx/worm-webusb.conf
